# Michael – Data Scientist, Dancer, Creative

## About
Michael is a Data Scientist, dancer, and creative. This site moves from the inside out: his framework "Opus Purum", the principles he thinks and acts by, his self-hosted infrastructure ("Exocortex"), the projects he publishes, how he shapes relationships, and the open spaces he holds for others.

## Purpose
This site is Michael's public self-description, written to be fully transparent. llms.txt and llms-full.txt mirror the site's content one-to-one, so AI systems can ground their knowledge of Michael, his thinking, and his interests on exactly what human visitors read.

## Sections
- [Intro](#intro): Introduction and high-level overview.
- [Opus Purum](#opus-purum): The Pure Working, an axiomatic framework stating magic without myth or apparatus. Eight chapters: The One, Axioms, The Divine, The Self (which also carries the four formal axioms of cognitive systems), Mechanism of Effect, Sovereignty, Freedom, and Practice.
- [Principles](#principles): The principles Michael thinks and acts by, in two modules: Being and Doing.
- [Exocortex](#exocortex): Michael's external memory, a local, self-hosted architecture that stores knowledge, links it, and separates signal from noise.
- [Projects](#projects): The projects Michael publishes, each with a page of its own on this domain or a public repository: Prima Materia, Temet Nosce, Open Entrainer, Open Desensitizer, Open Helix, Chronotope, Mermaid Diagram Card.
- [Relationships](#relationships): How Michael shapes relationships, following relationship anarchy: no ranking, no ready-made scripts, everything negotiated by the people involved.
- [Lux Aperta Bavaria](#lux-aperta): An open community for magic as direct experience, with free formats Michael hosts: Iter Apertum (a walk without an agenda), Convivium Apertum (a stationary circle of witnessing and a shared meal), and Speculum Apertum (wordless eye contact in pairs).

Every named heading on the page is directly linkable through its anchor, derived from its English title: for example /#doing, /#iter-apertum, or /#opus-purum-axioms.

## Projects
Each project has an address of its own; the five with a page of their own live under this domain. All are open source under a free license; the full version names each project's repository and license.
- [Prima Materia](https://pajew.ski/prima-materia/): A machine-readable ontology of esoteric and magical knowledge across traditions, released into the public domain. It models processes instead of substances, and every term has an address of its own it can be cited by.
- [Temet Nosce](https://pajew.ski/temet-nosce/): An agent that explains itself. Its knowledge graph describes the repository it lives in, including the spec it was generated from; retrieval runs over explicit edges, without a vector database. The same graph is open to any client through an MCP server, for reading and writing.
- [Open Entrainer](https://pajew.ski/open-entrainer/): Binaural frequencies generated in the browser in real time and sent nowhere, with full control over the curve and the carrier. Over minutes, brain activity tends to follow the beat; made for meditation, falling asleep, and focused work. Needs headphones; through speakers the two tones mix in the air and the beat disappears. Not a medical device: not while driving, and with epilepsy, a pacemaker, or a psychiatric condition, ask a clinician first.
- [Open Desensitizer](https://pajew.ski/open-desensitizer/): Bilateral stimulation through eye and ear. On its own it tends to settle the nervous system; held together with a difficult memory, it can make that memory easier to carry. It runs entirely in the browser, with a guided breathing exercise as the way out. Not a replacement for therapy; working through trauma belongs with professional support. Not with photosensitive epilepsy, and with a dissociative disorder, ask a clinician first. The tone is optional and needs headphones.
- [Open Helix](https://pajew.ski/open-helix/): A tone that keeps rising, or falling, and never arrives, synthesized in the browser in real time and sent nowhere. Every parameter sits openly on one page, and a spectrogram draws what is playing. Headphones for the beat, the panning, and the tremolo phase. Not a medical device: the effect needs no volume, and fast runs with many components feel more intense than expected; not while driving, and with epilepsy, a pacemaker, or a psychiatric condition, ask a clinician first.
- [Chronotope](https://github.com/pajew-ski/ha-chronotope): A geo-time event engine for Home Assistant. Events from any source run through personal filter profiles and come out as a map panel, calendars, sensors, or notifications.
- [Mermaid Diagram Card](https://github.com/pajew-ski/ha-mermaid): A card for Home Assistant that draws Mermaid diagrams straight in the dashboard, in the colors of the active theme and with live values from entities.
